title: NFIP General Property Form and RCBAP Flood Policies (Write Your Own): Building Amount Sharing the Layer on a Contents Payment
content:
Where the other flood policy's deductible layer spans both building and contents at the address, a contents payment on the NFIP General Property Form and RCBAP Flood Policies (Write Your Own) shares that layer with the building amount sworn for the date of loss.

**Rule.** The building amount sworn for the date of loss that shares the deductible layer is settled as follows, every case requiring that BizFlood policy to declare a building value for the address: when the latest building proof of loss for the date of loss was received after the proof-of-loss period, it is the amounts sworn on the other building proofs of loss for the date of loss added together; when building proofs of loss were filed for the date of loss and the latest was received within that period, it is the amounts sworn on all of them added together; when no building proof of loss was filed for the date of loss but building payments were issued for it on the adjuster's report signed in lieu of a proof of loss, it is those building payments less the building payment items voided; otherwise it is nothing.

That BizFlood policy is the named insured's BizFlood policy whose statement of values schedules the building's address, in force on the date of loss and not written excess of the National Flood Insurance Program. The proof-of-loss period is 60 calendar days after the date of loss.

## Truth table

| Building value declared for the address | Building proofs of loss for the date of loss | Building amount sharing the layer |
|---|---|---|
| yes | latest received after day 60 | total of the others |
| yes | latest received by day 60 | total of all |
| yes | none; building payments on the adjuster's report signed in lieu | those payments less voided items |
| yes | none, and no such payments | nothing |
| no | any | nothing |

## Case (hypothetical)

Building proofs of loss of 70,000.00 and 20,000.00 for the date of loss, latest received on day 45, and a building value declared on the statement of values: 90,000.00 shares the layer.
